property_summary: For any admissible addresses, after initialize(_baseToken=_nft=_x,...) the stored baseToken must equal the _baseToken argument (c.baseToken() == _baseToken); the mutant stores _nft, so any input with _baseToken != _nft breaks it.
change_summary: Replace 'baseToken = _baseToken;' with 'baseToken = _nft;' so baseToken is set to the NFT address instead.
